description: What the bundled page in ui/ may ask the app for, on the three desktop platforms. It asks for nothing: the shell drives every plugin from Rust, and the page carries the whole of its own behaviour (a probe, a Retry, a link) in one script file. So the core baseline is the whole allowlist, and no remote address is listed here — which is what keeps the app's IPC surface away from the page served at app.curule.dev. Android and iOS are the same grant, in mobile.json.
